2. Find the value in January 3, 2004 (final value) = **81.52**

$$
\text{Rate of Return} = \frac{\text{Final Value} - \text{Initial Value}}{\text{Initial Value}}
$$

- Subtract(final value, initial value)
- Divide(#0, initial value)
